title: 第25章 本大王打小天赋异禀第26章 这才是本大王的正确修炼方式
content_zh:
“我！”
白锦儿又紧张了起来，她支支吾吾地保证道：“我曾教过不少师弟师妹引气入体，他们……他们可都没问题的呀！”
他们没问题……
难道是本大王的问题？
纯小白挠着脑门，一脸疑惑。
“这引气入体，一般最快的要多久？”
白锦儿想了想，回答道：“我青云宗最快引气入体的记录，是内门的一位天骄师姐保持的，听说他……一息入道。”
“这么快？！”纯小白一脸惊讶。
入道可不只是引气入体。
引气入体，只是感受到灵气；而入道，是将灵气引入体内，循环一个大周天，成功突破到炼气一层。
那家伙竟然只用了几秒？
他已经按照这功法要求在脑子里模拟运行了几百个周天了，别说引气入体，连灵气是个啥玩意儿都没摸到过。
紧接着，他又不死心地问道：“那最慢的呢？”
“如果只是感应到第一缕灵气的话，”白锦儿犹豫了一下，还是说了实话，“即便是悟性再差的弟子，最慢……三天也能引到第一缕灵气了。”
“呃！”
纯小白的心情瞬间低落了下来。
说实话，他的悟性并不差，相反，以前在山上的时候，那些二当家、三当家都夸他悟性逆天。
无论什么武功招式，他压根不用看心法，只要照着别人的动作比划一遍，就能使得八九不离十。
难道……是没有灵根的原因？
可他从方元那里打听过。

感气跟灵根没有关系，灵根的作用只是将灵气转化为自身灵力。
据说只要家里有矿，即便没有灵根，也可以购买“转灵丹”，用药物转化灵气，同样能做到入道修仙。
“行了行了，你先回去吧，”纯小白烦躁地挥挥手。
“让本大王自己再琢磨琢磨。”
“哦！”白锦儿站起身，想说些什么安慰的话，但张了张嘴，最后还是没说出口。
她小心翼翼地退了出去，顺手将静室的门轻轻带上。
她知道，这很可能是纯小白杂灵根的原因，但又觉得有些不像。
自己这几乎是把法门嚼碎了喂给他。
掰开了揉碎了讲，这都快一个时辰了，即便是最差的杂灵根，也该能感受到一丝丝灵气才对。
紧接着，她脸上的疑惑又被忧心取代。
纯小白只是一个杂役弟子，现在却混到了外门，如果被执法堂发现，轻则废除修为，逐出宗门。
重则，直接当成别的宗门派来的细作，抽魂炼魄。
想到这里，她俏脸又是一白，忍不住看了看身后的洞府。
这样的事以前就发生过。
那些会在宗门中，身份不明的弟子，无论是谁，全都被执法堂抓去直接抽魂拷问，最终都落了个魂飞魄散的凄惨下场。
“等纯师兄……入道后，再劝他离开吧。”白锦儿在心中暗下决定。
……
修炼室内，纯小白抓耳挠腮，有些搞不懂这修仙的门道。
“难道老子还真要打道回府，回黑风寨等着当皇帝？”
不过他又觉得不对。

自己冥想睡着，可不是因为贪睡。
而是他能真切地感受到，只要按照那《青云诀》的法门运行，脑子里便自然而然地传来一股困意。
content_en:
"Me!"
Bai Jin'er became nervous again, and she promised hesitantly: "I have taught many junior brothers and sisters to introduce Qi into the body, and they... they are all fine!"
They have no problem…
Is it the king’s problem?
Chun Xiaobai scratched his forehead, looking confused.
"How long does it usually take to introduce Qi into the body the fastest?"
Bai Jin'er thought for a while and replied: "The record of our Qingyun Sect's fastest ability to introduce Qi into the body is held by a Tianjiao senior sister from the inner sect. I heard that he... entered the Tao in one breath."
"So fast?!" Chun Xiaobai looked surprised.
Entering the Tao is not just about introducing Qi into the body.
Introducing Qi into the body is just to feel the spiritual energy; and entering the Tao is to introduce the spiritual energy into the body, circulate it for a long time, and successfully break through to the first level of Qi refining.
That guy only took a few seconds?
He has been simulating this technique in his mind for hundreds of days, and he has never even touched the aura, let alone introducing the energy into his body.
Then, he asked persistently: "What about the slowest one?"
"If you only sense the first ray of spiritual energy," Bai Jin'er hesitated for a moment, but still told the truth, "even a disciple with poor understanding will be able to attract the first ray of spiritual energy in at least... three days."
"Ugh!"
Chun Xiaobai's mood instantly dropped.
To be honest, his understanding is not bad. On the contrary, when he was on the mountain, the second and third masters all praised his understanding.
No matter what martial arts moves, he doesn't have to look at his mind at all. He just needs to follow other people's movements and he can make them inseparable.
Could it be...that it's because he doesn't have spiritual roots?
But he asked about it from Fang Yuan.
Sensing Qi has nothing to do with spiritual roots. The function of spiritual roots is only to convert spiritual energy into one's own spiritual power.
It is said that as long as you have a mine at home, even if you don't have spiritual roots, you can buy a "spiritual transformation pill" and use the medicine to transform spiritual energy, and you can also enter Taoism and cultivate immortality.
"Okay, okay, you go back first," Chun Xiaobai waved his hand irritably.
"Let me, the king, think about it myself."
"Oh!" Bai Jin'er stood up and wanted to say something to comfort her, but she opened her mouth and finally didn't say anything.
She carefully withdrew and gently closed the door of the quiet room.
She knew that this was probably due to pure Xiaobai's spiritual roots, but she felt that it was a bit different.
I almost chewed up the method and fed it to him.
After breaking it apart and crushing it, it has been almost an hour. Even with the worst miscellaneous spiritual roots, you should be able to feel a trace of spiritual energy.
Then, the confusion on her face was replaced by worry.
Chun Xiaobai is just a handyman disciple, but now he has wandered into the outer sect. If he is discovered by the Law Enforcement Hall, his cultivation will be revoked and he will be expelled from the sect.
More importantly, just treat it as a masterpiece sent by other sects to extract the soul and refine the soul.
Thinking of this, her pretty face turned pale again, and she couldn't help but look at the cave behind her.
This has happened before.
Those unidentified disciples who were in the sect, no matter who they were, were all captured by the Law Enforcement Hall and directly extracted and tortured. In the end, they all ended up with their souls scattered.
"Wait until Senior Brother Chun... enters Taoism, then persuade him to leave." Bai Jin'er secretly made a decision in her heart.
…
In the training room, Chun Xiaobai scratched his head and scratched his head, somewhat confused about the way of cultivating immortals.
"Do I really want to go back home and go back to Heifeng Village to wait to become emperor?"
But he felt something was wrong.
When I fell asleep meditating, it was not because I was snoozing.
But he could really feel that as long as he followed the method of "Qingyun Jue", he would naturally feel sleepy in his mind.
